user.description: Press the green button on the token to wake it, then pick it from the list.

data_description.address: Tokens that advertised in the last few seconds. The name ends with the number printed in the Żappka app.

abort.already_in_progress: Configuration flow is already in progress
abort.no_devices_found: No awake Triki found. Press its button and try again.

data.motion_gestures: Motion gestures (rotate, shake, tap, throw, flip)

data_description.sample_rate: Higher = snappier gestures, faster battery drain. Above 104 Hz BLE often cannot keep up.
data_description.idle_timeout: After this long without motion or button activity the stream drops to 26 Hz but the link stays up, so the button keeps working. Any activity restores the configured rate.
data_description.sleep_timeout: After this long without activity the link is dropped. The token then advertises for about 3 minutes before it sleeps, and the button is not seen until it has slept.
data_description.knob_step: How far the token has to turn on the table for one rotate event. 30° gives 12 events per full turn; smaller steps flood slow lights.
data_description.invert_rotation: Swap rotate_cw and rotate_ccw, for a token used upside down or a dimmer that feels backwards.
data_description.wake_as_press: The press that wakes the token ends before the link is up, so it is reported as wake. Also emit press on wake (a wake caused by movement then looks like a press too).
data_description.shake: Off by default. Several quick back-and-forth swings of the wrist. Turn on to test.
data_description.knob: Off by default. Reports turns around the vertical axis as rotate_cw / rotate_ccw. Turn on to test.
data_description.motion_gestures: Off by default: thresholds are not calibrated on hardware. Turn on to test.
data_description.multi_press: Off: press is reported right when the button is released. On: a press is delayed by the window below to tell single, double and triple apart.
data_description.multi_press_window: Longest pause between releasing the button and pressing it again that still counts as a double or triple press. Single presses are reported this long after release.
data_description.capture: Every connection writes a .jsonl file with raw BLE notifications and detected events. Turn off when done.

asleep.message: {name} is asleep; press its button to wake it up first.
